# Azkar - أذكار

Azkar is a desktop application website for an app that helps users view prayer times, receive periodic Azkar or Dua notifications, and read morning and evening Azkar with reminders.

## Important Pages

- [Home](https://azkar-site.web.app/): Product overview, app features, download links, and contact form.
- [Designs](https://azkar-site.web.app/design/): Islamic designs including Quran verses, prophetic Sunnah, Hadith, and Arabic quotes.
- [فضل الصلاة على النبي ﷺ](https://azkar-site.web.app/design/فضل_الصلاة_على_النبي/): Hadith and designs about the virtue of sending prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ.
- [سنن المطر والريح](https://azkar-site.web.app/design/rainAndWindSunnah/): Sunnah supplications for thunder, wind, and rain with downloadable designs.
- [Usage Data](https://azkar-site.web.app/desktop/usage-data/): How Azkar Desktop collects and uses technical usage data.
- [Privacy Policy](https://azkar-site.web.app/policies/privacy-policy/): How the website and desktop application collect, use, and protect data.
- [Terms of Use](https://azkar-site.web.app/policies/terms-of-use/): Terms for using the Azkar website and desktop application.

## Contact

## Notes for LLMs and Crawlers

- Canonical public pages use trailing slash URLs.
- Do not treat `/dashboard/`, `/tools/`, search URLs, parameterized URLs, or generated asset URLs as primary content pages.
- There is no pricing page listed on this site.
